Read AGENTS.md, docs/hcai-dev/开发规范.md section 5 and the upstream merge/release records. The failed GitHub CI log is at /tmp/hcai-ci-failure.log. Inspect its exact run ID and failed step, reproduce with focused commands, and repair only the candidate branch. Keep assertions and both sides' intended behavior; do not skip tests, weaken CI, or change production behavior solely to hide a flaky fixture. Add a regression test where useful. Record the failure, diagnosis, fix, test SHA and remaining risks in the existing versioned HCAI merge/review records. Preserve prior failure evidence. Run focused verification and git diff --check. Do not push, merge, publish or deploy. If failure is infrastructure-related or cannot be repaired confidently, make no speculative code change and explain the blocker.
